description: This Go test source file contains unit tests for the 'higherlower' game logic, including testing functions like ValidateGuess, GetPlayerGuess, game play sequences, and auxiliary methods. It implements a mock prompter for simulating user input and uses deterministic number generation for testing game flow.

methods.name: Select

methods.name: TestGamePlay
methods.description: Tests game play logic with different guesses and deterministic number outcomes.

methods.description: Verifies that newly created game instances initialize with correct current number within range.
